sharedPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original transparent deployable physical sci-fi module for GRIDSHARD, readable as an actual device at 32-48 pixels, not a symbolic emblem. Image 1 (our previous dock shield/blaster) and Image 2 (our current crossed swords) are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match their clean chunky premium casual-strategy 2.5D rendering, substantial mechanical volume, broad saturated color faces, crisp simplified bevel planes, deep clean edge contour, controlled pale upper-left highlights and shaded lower-right sides. Do not draw the reference shield/sword combination. The new subject must have a plausible housing, working component and integrated chassis/mount that communicate its function; not a floating logo or one-piece glyph. Original design, not a reproduction of another game's card or the supplied concept sheets. A few large readable mechanical parts; no tiny screws everywhere, text displays, scratches, gritty realism, photoreal chrome or complex wiring nests. Consistent shallow three-quarter view from slightly above, front and right-side volume visible. Center the complete single device, entire object visible with 10-12% clean transparent margin on every edge; balanced nearly square footprint, visually substantial at small size. A mounting foot may be an integral device component, never a separate decorative square UI plate. Real transparent alpha, no floor, cast ground shadow, card, UI frame, label, badge, title, digits, watermark, checkerboard, scene, extra tools or floating symbols. No external bloom, particles, smoke, firing beam or flame trail. Emitters may have bright colored material only inside the device. No moon, plus sign, snowflake, lightning-bolt silhouette or prohibition glyph in place of a machine. Subject and class colors:

items.subject: LASER EMITTER WEAPON MODULE. One compact short-barreled laser blaster mounted on its own small swivel foot; bold red armored upper housing and barrel collar dominate, graphite inner barrel, pale silver top bevels and one orange-red lens recessed into the muzzle. Clear mechanical weapon shape, short heavy rear power body, one broad power conduit and a single continuous barrel pointing toward the upper-right. Inspired by the recognizable chunky gun volume of our dock reference, but an original mounted industrial laser module, not a copied pistol. No shield, hand, separate batteries, lightning emblem or firing ray. Mostly saturated coral/crimson red rather than navy or cyan.

ENERGY SHIELD PROJECTOR DEVICE. One low compact cobalt-blue circular generator base with three chunky emitter ribs, projecting its own clearly bounded translucent ice-blue half-dome. A few broad curved panel seams, not a dense micro hex mesh. Blue physical emitter base must remain large and visible, distinguishable from armor. Bright cyan source recessed in the base, pale silver edging. A physical barrier generator, NOT a pointed handheld shield, crest or badge. No floating shield symbol or halo.

COOLING UNIT MACHINE. A squat emerald/mint-green chamfered rectangular radiator housing, one large pale icy-cyan three-blade cooling fan on the front, two short chunky curved coolant pipes integrated along one side, a few broad silver cooling fins. Clearly a physical blower/heat exchanger installed on its own housing feet, not a snowflake emblem or ice cube. Mint-green structural faces identify SUPPORT; icy blue is only the functional fan/coolant accent. No frost mist, icicles or separate frozen scenery.

POWER STORAGE MODULE. One compact bank of THREE thick vertical energy cells held together in one solid turquoise carrier chassis, visible warm amber cell interiors with dark silver terminal caps, one short broad copper busbar linking their tops and an integrated low turquoise base. The front middle cell slightly forward gives a compact staggered silhouette. This is one connected deployable energy pack, not loose coins or batteries laid around a gun. Turquoise structural identity with amber stored-energy accents. No huge lightning glyph, electrical arcs, digits or floating sparks.

WEAPON POWER AMPLIFIER DEVICE. One compact emerald-green induction/relay machine on its own chunky chassis: TWO upright thick copper coil columns with luminous lime-green interiors, a short silver upper coupling bridge and a broad green lower housing with two obvious output sockets. A few solid protected conduits connect coils to housing. This should look like installed power-boost hardware capable of feeding neighboring weapons, NOT a medical plus, generic cross, repair robot, battery bank, or a gun cluster. Green SUPPORT housings dominate; warm copper is restrained functional winding material. No floating arrows, separate weapons, external arcs or text.

ELECTROMAGNETIC DISRUPTOR MACHINE. One squat violet pulse-generator chassis with a thick upright horseshoe-shaped induction emitter bolted into it, a suspended-looking but physically bracketed small magenta capacitor visible in the emitter gap, and two short broad side cooling housings. Purple metal body, dark graphite recesses and pale lilac bevels. Clearly powered sabotage hardware, distinct from the green amplifier's twin coil columns. The horseshoe is mechanical with joined emitter tips, not a prohibition circle or badge. No diagonal slash, radiating rings, external lightning or standalone glyph.

AUTONOMOUS REPAIR ROBOT MODULE. One small unmanned squat mint/emerald-green service robot on two short chunky tracks, a single recessed ice-green sensor lens in its upper central body, and TWO stout articulated maintenance arms extending from the sides. One arm ends in a broad silver pincer, the other in a short welding/repair nozzle; both limbs stay close to the robot to create a compact readable silhouette. Green protective body panels, pale silver joints, dark track treads. Clearly an industrial self-operating repair unit, not a humanoid person, medical bag, crescent moon, plus sign, separate scene or copy of the pixel-art reference. No target machine being repaired, loose tools, welding sparks, cables floating around or cross emblems.

ARMORED PROTECTION ASSEMBLY. One empty compact cobalt-blue industrial chest/shoulder armor shell viewed in three-quarter, layered broad protective chest plates, two short thick shoulder covers, pale steel chamfered rims and a dark recessed neck opening. The shell is a tangible equipment module with visible thickness, not a person wearing it and not a flat kite shield or parallelogram icon. Three or four large protective plate groups, no tiny bolts, straps everywhere, human head, skin, heraldic emblem or text. Blue DEFENSE identity with restrained graphite and pale steel.

PULSE CANNON TURRET MODULE. One squat heavy coral-red rotary-base weapon with an oversized SHORT WIDE barrel, a large recessed orange-red pulse aperture and TWO broad armored side capacitor pods connected to its thick rear housing. The barrel points toward the upper-right in shallow three-quarter view; the open muzzle remains visible. Chunky red housings, graphite barrel recess, broad pale metal bevels. Distinct from LASER: wide short cannon bore, heavy side capacitors and squat chassis instead of a narrow blaster barrel. No separate ammo cells, bullets, firing ray, flames or floating target emblem.

LOADED MISSILE LAUNCHER MODULE. One compact angled rack holding exactly THREE short thick missiles, integrated into a single coral-red swivel mounting chassis. Pale silver missile bodies with red pointed nose cones and broad red rear fins, charcoal launch rails, warm-gold small mechanical pivots. All missiles remain visibly loaded and attached to the rack, none in flight. Mount and red armored rack are substantial, almost square balanced overall silhouette. Original simplified deployable hardware, not a lone floating rocket icon. No exhaust flames, smoke, blast, firing scene, loose ammunition or text.
